scope: Frontal dialogue portrait; world actor and deferred body are unchanged.

orientation.reason: Small chin-up adjustment around the Head joint; rotate the assembly to preserve the connected parts.

authoring_notes: The scene is the editable source of fitting. This sidecar records provenance and is never loaded to reset transforms or rebuild content.
The face source contains two disconnected shells with independent origins. Separating them preserves UVs and texture while allowing the chin tuft to follow Jaw independently of the moustache.
Jaw attachment rotation cancels the source Jaw rest orientation; changing the source rig requires checking this local fit again.
Native BoneAttachment3D nodes follow speech animation. Runtime speech scripts do not fit or create accessories.
Head source is modelled with an open mouth and cannot fully close cleanly. A replacement slightly parted source head remains separate art work.
These existing textures are 4096 square for the head and 2048 square for accessories; this is not an 8K texture replacement.
